title: Lena and the Witness
author: Silas Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Crane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
